description: Xbim.Essentials provides the foundational .NET libraries of the extensible Building Information Modelling toolkit. Its contributors publish interfaces for reading, writing, checking and querying buildingSMART IFC data. The README documents IFC2x3 and IFC4 schemas and STEP, IfcXml and IfcZip formats. This is software for user-supplied building models, with no fixed geography, observation period or geometric resolution. Source code is available on GitHub and packages through NuGet. The repository licence file states the Common Development and Distribution License, allowing free reuse under its terms. A separate Xbim.Geometry package is needed for geometric operations and visualisation, and the current release has specific .NET compatibility requirements. The library can prepare or inspect building information for digital-twin and simulation workflows, but it is not an energy or structural solver. Related record model-energyplus simulates building energy use; no direct conversion to its input format was verified. No building files were retrieved and no library operation was executed.
